description:
Police-recorded offences in Victoria by suburb and by council area, per financial year (July to June) for 2016-17 to 2025-26, by offence type.

Coverage: Victoria: 2,880 suburbs and towns and 79 council areas; financial years 2016-17 to 2025-26. Current to 2026-06-30. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/recorded-crime-vic`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**
